acceptedAnswer.text: G.K.M. Jarif Ur Rahim is the Founder & Lead Consultant of Rashik - The Awakening. He is a career strategist, technology consultant, educator, and spiritual guide based in Bangladesh. His core philosophy is 'Reconnecting Intelligence With The Soul.'

Rashik - The Awakening is a Career & Spiritual Consulting Zone that guides students, professionals, and institutions to navigate the future with clarity. It helps build successful careers and find mental/spiritual balance through strategic consulting and spiritual guidance.

Jarif offers comprehensive consulting services including System Architecture Consulting, Digital Transformation Strategy, Career Development Coaching, Technology Consulting, and Spiritual Guidance. He specializes in helping organizations and individuals align technology with purpose.

mainEntity.name: How can I work with Jarif?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can schedule a consultation through his website at jarifurrahim.one or consultant.jarifurrahim.one. He offers personalized consulting for individuals and organizations seeking digital transformation and career development.

mainEntity.name: What is the philosophy behind Rashik?

acceptedAnswer.text: The core philosophy is 'Reconnecting Intelligence With The Soul' - bridging the gap between modern technology and timeless wisdom. It emphasizes aligning technological advancement with human values, spiritual growth, and sustainable business practices.
